article.headline: Southeast Missouri State beats Lipscomb 86-79 as Drew Cooper scores 14
article.description: — Drew Cooper had 14 points as Southeast Missouri State opened the year Monday with an 86-79 win over Lipscomb.
article.linkText: Southeast Missouri State beats Lipscomb 86-79 as Drew Cooper scores 14

categories.description: Lipscomb Bisons @ Southeast Missouri State Redhawks

event.description: Lipscomb Bisons @ Southeast Missouri State Redhawks

keywords: Lipscomb Bisons @ Southeast Missouri State Redhawks
article.story: CAPE GIRARDEAU, Mo. -- — Drew Cooper had 14 points as Southeast Missouri State opened the year Monday with an 86-79 win over Lipscomb. Cooper had six rebounds for the Redhawks. P.J. Farmer scored 13 points while shooting 5 for 10 from the field, including 3 for 4 from beyond the arc, and added five rebounds. Fontaine Williams shot 4 for 8 from the field, including 2 for 3 from 3-point range, and 3 for 4 from the free-throw line to finish with 13 points. T.K. Simpkins led the way for the Bisons with 22 points. Devyn Martin added 13 points and 11 rebounds for Lipscomb. Titas Sargiunas finished with 12 points. Up next Southeast Missouri State hosts Webster on Wednesday, and Lipscomb visits Iowa on Tuesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
